subject: Re: MAP & stakeholder map for FinPay procurement
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@finpay.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@finpay.com>, Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@finpay.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Oct 2026 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up + MAP draft (post-call recap)

Hi Sophie — great to meet you and the FinPay team on the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a shared timeline: 

1) Decision criteria (what I heard):
- Latency under 200ms p95 for customer-facing flows
- Per-token unit economics aligned with current vendor spend
- SOC2+ & encryption controls for production data

2) Key stakeholders you mentioned:
- Economic buyer: Liam O'Connor (payments ops)
- Security & compliance: Emily Zhang
- Procurement: Carlos Mendez

3) Proposed MAP / milestones (draft attached):
- Week 1 (Oct 12–16): Technical deep-dive + SE demo (we'll scope test data)
- Week 3 (Oct 26–30): SOC2 questionnaire responses + security review
- Week 5 (Nov 9–13): Pilot contract / PO submission
- Week 7 (Nov 23–27): Pilot kickoff (1 month)

Attachments: FinPay-MAP-v1.pdf (MAP draft), FinPay-SOC2-questions.xlsx (SOC2 worksheet)

Ask: can you confirm the stakeholder list above and the timing that works for Liam and Emily? If those milestones look reasonable I can convert the MAP to a shared Google doc and we can track owners/dates.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198

From: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@finpay.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@finpay.com>, Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@finpay.com>, Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@finpay.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Oct 2026 17:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Follow-up + MAP draft (post-call recap)

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap. Confirming stakeholders are correct. A couple notes from our side: 

- Liam is the economic owner; he wants a short TCO comparison vs our incumbent before signing off on budget.
- Emily will lead the security review; she'll need the SOC2 worksheet filled out and we'd like a short call with your security engineer to go over deployment/networking assumptions.
- Procurement (Carlos) expects a draft SOW + standard PO terms; he's also the person who will drive timeline for PO issuance.

Timing: the suggested milestones look achievable. Quick asks:
1) Can you provide an estimated pilot pricing range we can share with Liam? (ballpark is fine)
2) Can you confirm who from Redwood will join the security call?

We'll review the MAP draft internally and get you back with availability for the technical deep-dive next week.

—Sophie
Sophie Turner
Head of Product Operations | FinPay
Sophie.Turner@finpay.com

Subject: FinPay MAP (v1) + pilot pricing range

Hi all — attaching the MAP v1 (PDF) and the SOC2 worksheet per Emily's note. A few updates below: 

Pilot pricing (ballpark):
- 1-month pilot with 5M tokens/month: $9k–$12k (depending on batching & quantization)
- Production estimate (example): $0.0008–$0.0012 / token for low-latency configs

Security call: Vivek (cc'd) will join as our security/solutions lead — he can run through network, encryption, and deployment options. Vivek, are you available for a 30-min sync next Thursday (Oct 22) or Fri (Oct 23)?

Next steps I propose:
- Sophie: confirm availability for technical deep-dive and share Liam/Emily windows
- Emily: flag any high-priority SOC2 items from the worksheet and we’ll pre-fill answers
- Carlos: if procurement has a template SOW you prefer, share and we’ll draft a version to match

I've also created a HubSpot MAP record so we can track milestones — link included above.

Thanks — Marissa

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: FinPay MAP — action items before security call

Vivek / Dylan — short internal note after Sophie confirmed stakeholders and asked for pricing & SE on the security call. Action items: 

- Vivek: please review the SOC2 worksheet I attached and prepare 20–30 min talking points around network isolation, KMS/HSM integrations, and data retention (target call Oct 22/23).
- Dylan: prep a short demo playbook focusing on low-latency setup (200ms p95 target) and a pilot success criteria doc we can share with Liam.
- I'll draft the SOW template with tentative pilot terms and share with Carlos once we have his procurement template.

Also, consider a modest pilot discount (10–15%) to reduce friction for PO approval — recommend we confirm discount band during commercial review.

Thanks — I’ll update the HubSpot MAP and add owners/dates once we lock the call.

—Marissa
